title: Rattleshirt's Raiders

wildlingVictory.lowestBidder: Is reduced 2 positions on the Supply track (to no lower than 0).
wildlingVictory.everyoneElse: Is reduced 1 positions on the Supply track (to no lower than 0).
wildlingVictory.note: Then reconcile armies to their new Supply limits.

playersVictory: Is increased 1 position on the Supply track (to no higher than 6).

title: Massing on the Milkwater

wildlingVictory.lowestBidder: If he has more than one House card in his hand, he discards all cards with the highest combat strength.
wildlingVictory.everyoneElse: If they have more than one House card in their hand, they must choose and discard one of those cards.

playersVictory: Returns his entire House card discard pile into his hand.

title: Mammoth Riders
playersVictory: May retrieve 1 House card of his choice from his House card discard pile.

title: Skinchanger Scout

wildlingVictory.everyoneElse: Discard 2 available Power tokens, or as many as they are able.

playersVictory: All Power tokens he bid on this attack are immediately returned to his available Power.

title: Preemptive Raid

wildlingVictory.lowestBidder: Chooses one of the following: A. Destroy 2 of his units anywhere. B. Is reduced 2 positions on his highest Influence track.

playersVictory: The wildlings immediately attack again with a strength of 6. You do not participate in the bidding against this attack (nor do you receive any rewards or penalties).

title: The Horde Descends

wildlingVictory.lowestBidder: Destroys 2 of his units at one of his Castles or Strongholds. If unable, he destroys 2 of his units anywhere.

playersVictory: May muster forces (following normal mustering rules) in any one Castle or Stronghold area he controls.

title: Crow Killers

wildlingVictory.lowestBidder: Replaces all of his Knights with available Footmen. Any Knight unable to be replaced is destroyed.
wildlingVictory.everyoneElse: Replaces 2 of his Knights with available Footmen. Any Knight unable to be replaced is destroyed.

playersVictory: May immediately replace up to 2 of his Footmen, anywhere, with available Knights.

title: A King Beyond the wall

wildlingVictory.lowestBidder: Moves his tokens to the lowest position of every Influence track.
wildlingVictory.everyoneElse: In turn order, each player chooses either the Fiefdoms or King's Court Influence track and moves his token to the lowest position of that track.

playersVictory: Moves his token to the top of one Influence track of his choice, then takes the appropriate Dominance token.
